settings.name: Parcel shipping documents (concerns the sender and recipient)
settings.description: This option allows to send email messages with shipping documents both to the sender and customer.

settings.name: Potwierdzenie nadania przesyłki (dotyczy odbiorcy)
settings.description: Opcja pozwala na wysyłanie wiadomości e-mail o nadaniu przesyłki z linkiem umożliwiającym jej śledzenie do odbiorcy.

settings.name: Monthly reports on delivered parcels
settings.description: Thanks to this option, you will receive a detailed report of parcels delivered last month.

settings.name: Monthly reports on COD parcels
settings.description: Thanks to this option, at the end of the month you will receive a detailed report of cash on delivery shipments ordered in the past month.

settings.name: Resignation from receiving the Terms and Conditions and the Pricelist
settings.description: With this option, the Terms and Conditions and the Pricelist are not attached to the e-mail notification confirming the shipment order.
